name: Ipregistry
summary: IP geolocation with connection, company, carrier, time zone, currency and security data (proxy, Tor, VPN, threat), Autonomous System lookups and User-Agent parsing.

host.description: API host: the default, eu.api.ipregistry.co to keep requests on EU nodes, or gb.api.ipregistry.co for UK nodes only.

api_key.description: An Ipregistry API key (Ipregistry dashboard). Sent in the Authorization header as 'ApiKey <key>'.

notes: Billing is in credits: 1 per single lookup; a batch costs one per value plus one per request (3 addresses cost 4).
Every endpoint takes fields to trim the response: comma-separated, dot syntax for nested fields (security.is_tor), a leading minus to exclude.
Batch lookups by POSTing a JSON array are not in this entry; comma-separated values in the path do the same over GET.

endpoints.name: Look up one or more IP addresses
endpoints.summary: Location, connection (ASN, ISP, type), company, carrier, time zone, currency and security flags for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, or up to 1,024 comma-separated addresses.

ip.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or up to 1,024 comma-separated addresses.

hostname.description: Also resolve the address's hostname; slows the response.

notes: 1 credit for one address; n + 1 for a batch, whose answers come wrapped in a results array.

endpoints.name: Look up one or more Autonomous Systems
endpoints.summary: Details of an Autonomous System by number, or of up to 16 comma-separated AS numbers.

asn.description: An AS number prefixed with AS, or up to 16 comma-separated ones.

notes: 1 credit for one AS; n + 1 for a batch.

endpoints.name: Parse a User-Agent string
endpoints.summary: Browser, device and operating system behind a User-Agent string.

ua.description: The User-Agent to parse; without it the caller's own HTTP client is parsed.
ua.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0
